moves.text: Set your lineup: start DeVonta Smith over Hunter Henry (win chance 95% → 96%).
David Njoku is healthy but still on IR. He can't score until you move him back to your roster.
Offer THE FINAL BOSS: Jayden Daniels for Patrick Mahomes.

reasons: You're 8-2 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 19%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 3rd of 10 contenders (154.0 points a week).
Your weakest position is TE (6th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 2nd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 3rd in 2028 (title chances about 19%, 21%, 24%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 19% to 23%, and your lineup comes out 0.2 points a week ahead overall. Jayden Daniels adds 13.7 points a week for you today, but Patrick Mahomes is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 6,024, get 5,741), and it barely changes their lineup (-0.2 a week).
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 21% and 24% to 20% and 23%.
You have 3 weeks until the trade deadline.
